sections.heading: 1. Bridge
lines: ① Lie on your back, knees bent, feet hip-width.
② Gently brace, lift the hips slowly.
③ Hold 3 sec × 10 reps, once or twice a day.
④ Roll down one segment at a time.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…

caption:
Koko spends weekends weeding and carrying soil bags. The next morning, straightening up feels hard work.

Long stretches bent over with straight legs keep the lower back muscles working the whole time. Kneeling on a pad, hinging at the hips and changing position every 20–30 minutes can often help.

Hybi's 1-minute Pilates: bridge, hold 3 seconds, 10 reps, once or twice a day. Clinical Pilates can help build hip and trunk strength and balance, step by step.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Chat to our team at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio
